title: Shadow Mode
description: A Claude Code Plugin that intercepts risky tool calls — Bash, Write, Edit — and logs exactly what would have happened instead of executing it. A /shadow-mode command toggles it live; a second, model-invoked skill summarizes a session's shadow log in plain English. Installable from a real self-hosted marketplace, validated against Anthropic's own plugin review checks.

title: Spec Drift Detector
description: Long Claude Code sessions quietly drift from the constraints they were given at the start. A Stop hook checks the last response against a written invariant checklist — deterministically first, then via a real model judgment — and blocks the turn from ending cleanly when something's wrong, with a safety valve so an unsatisfiable rule can't trap the session.

title: Agent Worker Pool
description: A fixed-size worker pool for running many Claude Code calls concurrently without melting a rate limit or the local machine — bounded backpressure and clean context-cancellation shutdown, benchmarked against an unbounded goroutine-per-task baseline with real numbers.

title: OpenSpec Conformance Checker
description: OpenSpec's own validate command checks a change's file format — it never checks whether the code that shipped actually matches the plan. A CLI that closes that exact gap, verified against an open issue in OpenSpec's own tracker: parses a change's tasks and spec deltas, diffs them against real git history, and flags drift deterministically first, an LLM's judgment only when that's not enough to decide.
